registrar_rulings.reason: Not priced anywhere: the live feed contains zero 'almond butter' strings under any id, and no row in commodities.json, recipe-commodities.json, the recipe-board baseline, or recipe-floor-id-map.json carries an almond spread. Mint almond-butter as recipe-only (recipe-board baseline + recipe-commodities.json) unless Brad promotes it to the weekly worklist. Prescription: include ['almond\s+butter']; build the exclude list to neighbor rigor — at minimum cookie/cookie butter, body butter, powdered, baby-food brands (beech nut, gerber, stage 1-3), candy/chocolate/bar, granola, protein bar, spread blends, flavored coffee/creamer — model on peanut-butter's list. Add commodity-dupe-allowlist.json pairs (almond-butter, butter: 'nut spread vs dairy, different foods') and (almond-butter, peanut-butter: 'different nut, deliberate variant') so audit-commodity-dupes.ps1 never re-flags the shared 'butter' token. Separately on the NAME namespace: the vocabulary has no Almond Butter row (nearest are Peanut Butter and Butter, neither of which this resolves to), so a new vocabulary row 'Almond Butter' is needed too — FDC 168603 (almond butter, plain, with salt) is the plausible macros source but that row must be minted through the vocabulary path, not as a side effect of this id ruling.
